reports.summary: GBAutomation adopts full-tree trace attribution as the standard level of observability detail. Every agent runtime must emit the complete Langfuse observation tree (CHAIN/SPAN/TOOL/GENERATION linked by parentObservationId) with resolved model, usageDetails (incl. cache reads), tool names + args, and structured repo/slug/branch tags. The telemetry-report skill is the canonical consumer and must attribute token spend by tool and by output file type.
reports.title: ADR 2026-06-02 — Full-Tree Trace Attribution Standard

reports.summary: The gbautomation.xyz contact form lost [redacted-local-path]5 months of lead notifications after its contact-notify Lambda was deleted. Rebuilt the notifier as a cron poll, migrated the form off a stale standalone Supabase project onto the canonical gbauto project, locked the leads table with RLS, and deployed the poller as a Mac Mini launchd job.
reports.title: ADR 2026-05-19 — contact-form notifier + gbauto Supabase migration

reports.summary: ADR to actually use the Hermes Kanban board as a live worker queue. Linear stays the source-of-truth for shipped work; Kanban becomes the durable claim/run/heartbeat layer that lets autonomous agents pick up ready tasks without Greg-in-the-loop dispatch.

reports.summary: Every Windows Task Scheduler GBAutomation-* job runs through scripts/Invoke-WithReceipt.ps1, which emits a host-job-run.v1 receipt, pushes it to public.host_job_runs in Supabase, and edge-triggers a Telegram nudge on ok->failed transition. Validation gates every new task through resources/skills/validate-cron-deploy/.
reports.title: ADR 2026-05-16 — scheduled-task receipts + validate gate

reports.summary: Fold mac-mini-job-run.v1 + scheduled-task-run.v1 into one host-job-run.v1 envelope; rename public.mac_mini_runs → public.host_job_runs with additive columns; preserve legacy rows; deprecate insert_mac_mini_run_to_supabase.py as a re-exec for one release cycle.

proof.sourceQuote: ADR 2026-05-12 — `gbauto-supabase` CLI via Printing Press pattern

reports.sourceQuote: ADR 2026-05-12 — `gbauto-supabase` CLI via Printing Press pattern
reports.summary: Build a purpose-built `gbauto-supabase` CLI (Printing Press pattern) as the single, isolated Supabase tool surface for every environment — Mac Mini, Windows dev, Linear CI, future per-client agents. Lives in services/gbauto_supabase/, installable via `uv tool install` so no global brew/npm dependency, no MCP per session, and one secret resolver everywhere.
reports.title: ADR 2026-05-12 — `gbauto-supabase` CLI via Printing Press pattern
